scripts.verify: npm run verify:harness && npm run verify:api && npm run verify:mcp && npm run verify:web && npm run verify:e2e
scripts.verify:harness: tsc -p scripts/test && eslint --config scripts/test/eslint.config.mjs scripts/test && vitest run --root scripts/test
scripts.verify:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api pytest -q
scripts.verify:mcp: uv run --directory apps/mcp --frozen ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/mcp --frozen pytest -q
scripts.verify:web: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
